fullPassage: Life is full of possibilities. If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. But if we, like carpenters, always try to "shape" children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others' instructions. Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a "perfect" piece according to our will. The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own "map" to find their direction in a complex world.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 grow를 수식하는 자리이므로 부사가 와야 한다. 명사 nature를 형용사 natural을 거쳐 부사 naturally로 바꾼다. grow naturally at their own pace.
det.tip: nature(명사) → natural(형용사) → naturally(부사)

questions.passage: Life is full of possibilities. If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. But if we, like carpenters, always try to "shape" children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to __________. Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. As parents, our role should be that of gardeners, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a "perfect" piece according to our will. The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own "map" to find their direction in a complex world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: following others' instructions = 남의 지시를 따르는 것
det.analysis:
빈칸은 목수(carpenter)식으로 길러진 아이가 '자율성을 잃고' 익숙해지는 것이며, 뒤에서 '남이 정해주는 것에 익숙하다'로 재진술된다.

✅ ① following others' instructions(남의 지시를 따르는 것): '남이 정해주는 것에 익숙하다'와 일치 ← 정답

❌ ② exploring the world freely(세상을 자유롭게 탐험하는 것): 정원사식 아이의 긍정적 특성이라 반대

❌ ③ choosing their own path(스스로 길을 선택하는 것): 바로 뒤 '능동적으로 길을 선택하기보다'와 모순

❌ ④ understanding life deeply(삶을 깊이 이해하는 것): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: becoming accustomed to following others' instructions

questions.passage: Life is full of possibilities. If we, like gardeners, provide a suitable environment and let children grow at their own pace, they will spontaneously explore the world, developing curiosity, creativity, and independence. Such children love life, dare to challenge, and possess initiative. But if we, like carpenters, always try to "shape" children into our ideal image, they will gradually lose autonomy, becoming accustomed to following others' instructions. Such children quickly lose their sense of direction as they grow, because they are used to being arranged for, rather than actively choosing their path. As parents, our role should be __________, providing sunlight, rain, and fertile soil, allowing children to grow naturally at their own pace. It should not be that of carpenters, trying to carve out a "perfect" piece according to our will. The core of education starts with understanding life and helping children find their own "map" to find their direction in a complex world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
글 전체는 '부모의 역할은 목수(carpenter)가 아니라 정원사(gardener)여야 한다'는 요지다. 빈칸 뒤 '햇빛·비·비옥한 토양을 제공해 아이가 자연스럽게 자라게 한다'와 '목수의 역할이어서는 안 된다'로 이어진다.

❌ ① that of carpenters(목수의 역할): 바로 뒤 '목수의 역할이어서는 안 된다'와 정반대

❌ ② a strict schedule(엄격한 일정): 정원사 비유와 안 맞음

❌ ③ a fixed mold(고정된 틀): 오히려 목수식(틀에 맞춤)이라 반대

✅ ④ that of gardeners(정원사의 역할): 아이를 자연스럽게 자라게 하는 역할과 일치 ← 정답
det.tip: our role should be that of gardeners ... not ... that of carpenters
